title: Attend
subtitle: 「出席／參加／到場」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「出席／參加／到場」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 最自然、最日常的替代表達之一。
words.example: Are you going to the meeting tomorrow?
words.exampleZh: 你明天會去參加會議嗎？

exercises.original: Are you going to attend the meeting tomorrow?
exercises.zh: 你明天會去參加會議嗎？
exercises.upgrade: go to · 去參加

options.explanation: 最自然、最日常地表示出席某個活動。
表示組織會議，不等於參加。
可以遠端觀看，但不代表親身出席。

exercises.original: She attends yoga classes every Saturday.
exercises.zh: 她每星期六都去上瑜伽課。
exercises.upgrade: She goes to yoga classes every Saturday.

options.explanation: 日常課堂語境中和 attends 很接近。

exercises.original: We attended a concert after dinner.
exercises.zh: 我們晚餐後去參加了一場音樂會。
exercises.upgrade: We went to a concert after dinner.

options.explanation: 表示演出，不等於觀眾出席。

words.note: 較正式，強調某人在某個活動或場合「實際在場」。
words.example: All department heads were present at the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 所有部門主管都有出席會議。

exercises.original: All department heads attended the meeting.
exercises.zh: 所有部門主管都有出席會議。
exercises.upgrade: All department heads were present at the meeting.

exercises.original: Several witnesses attended the hearing.
exercises.zh: 數名目擊者出席了聽證會。
exercises.upgrade: Several witnesses were present at the hearing.

exercises.original: The director attended the ceremony in person.
exercises.zh: 主管親身出席了典禮。
exercises.upgrade: The director was present at the ceremony in person.

options.explanation: in person 強烈支持「親身在場」。

words.note: 表示不只是到場，而是有實際參與活動。
words.example: More than 200 students participated in the workshop.
words.exampleZh: 超過二百名學生參加了工作坊。

exercises.original: More than 200 students attended the workshop and completed the activities.
exercises.zh: 超過二百名學生參加工作坊並完成了活動。
exercises.upgrade: More than 200 students participated in the workshop.

options.explanation: 完成活動說明不是單純到場，而是有實際參與。

exercises.original: She attended the discussion and contributed several ideas.
exercises.zh: 她參與討論並提出了幾個想法。
exercises.upgrade: She participated in the discussion and contributed several ideas.

options.explanation: contributed ideas 顯示主動參與。

exercises.original: Employees attended the training exercises rather than simply observing them.
exercises.zh: 員工實際參與了訓練活動，而不是只旁觀。
exercises.upgrade: Employees participated in the training exercises rather than simply observing them.

words.note: 和 participate in 非常接近，但更自然、稍口語。
words.example: She took part in the training session.

exercises.original: She attended the charity run as a participant.
exercises.zh: 她以參賽者身份參加慈善跑。
exercises.upgrade: She took part in the charity run.

options.explanation: 參賽者身份明確表示實際參與。

exercises.original: Students attended the science activity and carried out experiments.
exercises.zh: 學生參與科學活動並進行實驗。
exercises.upgrade: Students took part in the science activity.

options.explanation: 實際進行實驗，適合 take part in。

exercises.original: He attended the competition and completed all three rounds.
exercises.zh: 他參加了比賽並完成所有三輪。
exercises.upgrade: He took part in the competition and completed all three rounds.

options.explanation: 有完成比賽回合，明顯是參賽。

words.note: 表示加入某個活動、會議、團體或一群人。
words.example: Will you join us for the seminar?
words.exampleZh: 你會和我們一起參加研討會嗎？

exercises.original: Will you attend us for the seminar?
exercises.zh: 你會加入我們一起參加研討會嗎？
exercises.upgrade: Will you join us for the seminar?

options.explanation: 固定自然結構 join us for...。

exercises.original: Several new members attended the discussion halfway through.
exercises.zh: 幾名新成員在討論進行到一半時加入。
exercises.upgrade: Several new members joined the discussion halfway through.

options.explanation: 加入正在進行的活動很自然。

exercises.original: She attended the online meeting after finishing another call.
exercises.zh: 她完成另一通電話後加入了網上會議。
exercises.upgrade: She joined the online meeting after finishing another call.

options.explanation: 網上會議最自然用 join。

words.note: 非常正式，常見於正式活動、官方場合或書面報道。
words.example: Several senior officials were in attendance at the ceremony.
words.exampleZh: 多名高級官員出席了典禮。

exercises.original: Several senior officials attended the ceremony.
exercises.zh: 多名高級官員出席了典禮。
exercises.upgrade: Several senior officials were in attendance at the ceremony.

exercises.original: Members of the royal family attended the opening event.
exercises.zh: 皇室成員出席了開幕活動。
exercises.upgrade: Members of the royal family were in attendance at the opening event.

exercises.original: Several ambassadors attended the reception.
exercises.zh: 數名大使出席了招待會。
exercises.upgrade: Several ambassadors were in attendance at the reception.

options.explanation: 正式外交活動語境自然。

words.note: 口語常見，強調「有沒有真的出現」。
words.example: He didn't show up for the appointment.

exercises.original: He didn't attend the appointment.
exercises.zh: 他沒有到場赴約。
exercises.upgrade: He didn't show up for the appointment.

options.explanation: 口語地強調「有沒有出現」。

exercises.original: Only half the registered participants attended the session.
exercises.zh: 只有一半已登記參加者真的到場。
exercises.upgrade: Only half the registered participants showed up for the session.

options.explanation: registered vs actually came 是典型 show up 語境。

exercises.original: She attended the interview ten minutes early.
exercises.zh: 她提早十分鐘到場參加面試。
exercises.upgrade: She showed up for the interview ten minutes early.

words.note: 和 show up for 很接近，英式英語尤其常見。
words.example: Only ten people turned up for the lecture.

exercises.original: Only ten people attended the lecture.
exercises.zh: 只有十個人出席講座。
exercises.upgrade: Only ten people turned up for the lecture.

exercises.original: He failed to attend the training session.
exercises.zh: 他沒有到場參加培訓。
exercises.upgrade: He failed to turn up for the training session.

exercises.original: Everyone who attended the rehearsal received a schedule.
exercises.zh: 所有到場參加排練的人都收到時間表。
exercises.upgrade: Everyone who turned up for the rehearsal received a schedule.

options.explanation: 有些人可能只是工作人員，不一定表演。

words.note: 如果活動的位置是以說話者／主辦方為中心，come to 很自然。
words.example: Thanks for coming to the event.
words.exampleZh: 謝謝你來參加這個活動。

exercises.original: Thank you for attending the event.
exercises.zh: 謝謝你來參加這個活動。
exercises.upgrade: Thank you for coming to the event.

options.explanation: 以主辦方／現場為視角非常自然。

exercises.original: Are you attending the party tonight?
exercises.zh: 你今晚會來參加派對嗎？
exercises.upgrade: Are you coming to the party tonight?

exercises.original: Many parents attended the school concert.
exercises.zh: 很多家長來參加學校音樂會。
exercises.upgrade: Many parents came to the school concert.

options.explanation: 自然表示來到活動現場。

words.note: 常見口語表達，尤其英式英語，語氣比 attend 輕鬆。
words.example: I might go along to the talk after work.
words.exampleZh: 我下班後可能會去聽那場講座。

exercises.original: I might attend the talk after work.
exercises.zh: 我下班後可能會去聽那場講座。
exercises.upgrade: I might go along to the talk after work.

options.explanation: 輕鬆口語地表示去參加一下。

exercises.original: She attended the local book club meeting out of curiosity.
exercises.zh: 她出於好奇去參加本地讀書會。
exercises.upgrade: She went along to the local book club meeting out of curiosity.

options.explanation: out of curiosity 很符合「去看看」語感。

exercises.original: We decided to attend the community event for an hour.
exercises.zh: 我們決定去參加社區活動一小時。
exercises.upgrade: We decided to go along to the community event for an hour.

options.explanation: 短暫、隨意參加活動很自然。

words.note: 表示出席某堂課、會議或討論，但通常不是正式參與者。
words.example: She sat in on the meeting to learn how the team worked.
words.exampleZh: 她列席會議，以了解團隊如何運作。

exercises.original: She attended the meeting as an observer.
exercises.zh: 她以旁觀者身份列席會議。
exercises.upgrade: She sat in on the meeting as an observer.

options.explanation: 旁聽／列席但非主要參與者，完全符合。

exercises.original: The trainee attended one of the senior manager's interviews to observe.
exercises.zh: 實習生旁聽了一次高級經理的面試，以作觀察。
exercises.upgrade: The trainee sat in on one of the senior manager's interviews.

options.explanation: 觀察學習而非主持，非常自然。

exercises.original: Visitors may attend one class before deciding whether to enrol.
exercises.zh: 訪客可先旁聽一堂課，再決定是否報讀。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors may sit in on one class before deciding whether to enrol.

options.explanation: 未正式報讀但旁聽，非常典型。

words.note: 表示加入正在進行的活動。
words.example: Everyone was encouraged to join in the discussion.
words.exampleZh: 大家都被鼓勵參與討論。

exercises.original: Everyone was encouraged to attend the discussion actively.
exercises.zh: 大家都被鼓勵積極加入討論。
exercises.upgrade: Everyone was encouraged to join in the discussion.

options.explanation: 強調加入正在進行的活動。

exercises.original: The children attended the singing activity with the rest of the group.
exercises.zh: 孩子們和其他人一起加入歌唱活動。
exercises.upgrade: The children joined in the singing activity with the rest of the group.

exercises.original: Even the quieter students attended the group exercise.
exercises.zh: 即使較安靜的學生也加入了小組活動。
exercises.upgrade: Even the quieter students joined in the group exercise.

words.note: 常見口語表達，表示某人會在某個活動或重要時刻出現。
words.example: I'll be there for the presentation tomorrow.
words.exampleZh: 我明天會到場參加簡報。

exercises.original: I'll attend your presentation tomorrow.
exercises.zh: 我明天會到場參加你的簡報。
exercises.upgrade: I'll be there for your presentation tomorrow.

exercises.original: She promised to attend the award ceremony.
exercises.zh: 她答應會到場參加頒獎禮。
exercises.upgrade: She promised to be there for the award ceremony.

options.explanation: 有「重要時刻會到場」的語感。

exercises.original: Don't worry—I will attend the meeting.
exercises.zh: 別擔心——我會到場參加會議。
exercises.upgrade: Don't worry—I will be there for the meeting.

words.word: Attend regularly → Go regularly / be a regular attendee
words.note: 當 attend 表示持續／習慣性參加時，可自然改寫為 go regularly 或 be a regular attendee。

exercises.original: She attends evening classes every week.
exercises.zh: 她每星期都定期上晚間課程。
exercises.upgrade: She goes regularly to evening classes.

exercises.original: He attends the monthly club meeting without fail.
exercises.zh: 他每月都固定出席俱樂部會議。
exercises.upgrade: He is a regular attendee at the monthly club meeting.

options.explanation: 名詞結構自然表達固定出席者。

exercises.original: Many children attend the centre after school each day.
exercises.zh: 很多孩子每天放學後都定期去這個中心。
exercises.upgrade: Many children go regularly to the centre after school each day.

options.explanation: 持續習慣性到訪／參加最合適。

falseSynonyms.zh: 到訪不一定等於出席 visit 強調去某個地方或見某個人；attend 強調參加一個活動或場合。 我們參觀博物館。 我們出席博物館的開幕典禮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We visited the museum. We attended the museum's opening ceremony.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觀看不等於出席 你可以 watch an event remotely，完全沒有到場。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I watched the concert online. I attended the concert in person.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觀察不等於參加 observe 強調看、留意或監察，不一定成為活動參與者。
主持／主辦不等於出席 host 是主辦或接待活動的人；attendee 是出席者。
組織活動不等於出席活動 主辦人當然可能同時出席，但兩個動作不同。
參與通常比 attend 更強 你可以 attend a meeting 但整場不發言；如果 participate，通常表示有實際參與。
attend to 不等於 attend attend to = 處理；照顧；留意。 她出席了會議。 她處理／照顧那位顧客的需要。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She attended the meeting. She attended to the customer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性不同 - attend = 動詞，出席 - attendance = 名詞，出席／出席人數 - attendee = 名詞，出席者
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She attended the conference. Attendance was high. Each attendee received a badge.
